why: 0039, 0041, 0042 and 0043 all declared after the fact, or never, or declared something the prose then contradicted. This file is the declaration, it is written first, and the read-back at the end of the batch is against it and against the prose, and the prose wins. The 0043 allocation failed in two shapes before any prose existed — it counted the incoming gap as an internal one and it put a chapter on the eleventh of a month. Neither happened here.

family.name: THE NINTH
family.one_sentence: SOMEONE HAS ALREADY DECIDED HOW A THING IS GOING TO GO, AND A SECOND PERSON STANDS IN FRONT OF THEM AND ASKS WHY, AND THE CHAPTER IS A DAY ON WHICH THE ONE WHO DECIDED HAS TO SAY A REASON OUT LOUD.
family.test_against_595_604: It cannot be summed as someone did a small thing and it went nowhere, because nothing has been done yet. What exists on the page is an intention and a reason given for it. The bin is still at the kerb. The shopping is still in the list.
family.test_against_605_614: It cannot be summed as someone carried a thing they could not put down, because a decision has an owner and a direction and can be acted on. The trouble in this batch is the opposite of a weight: it is that the decision can be carried out and the reason for it cannot be taken back once it has been said in front of somebody.
family.test_against_615_624: It cannot be summed as somebody was told a thing they could not place, because nobody in any of these ten is told anything they cannot place. Every piece of information in the batch is given face to face and is understood by the person who receives it. The difficulty is not where the words came from. The difficulty is what the words have to be answered with.
family.the_engine: The 0043 batch found that a chapter in its own family only catches when somebody could have asked and did not, and when the not-asking costs something visible. That finding is kept and turned over. In the eighth family the world was indifferent and the person did not ask. In this one the world is not indifferent, the world stands in front of them and asks, and the resistance is entirely inside the person who decided. Every chapter has somebody who could say no and says a reason instead.
family.flag: NO WRITER HAS EVER NAMED ONE OF THESE FAMILIES. THE NINTH IS A WRITER'S AND NOT A HUMAN'S, EXACTLY AS THE EIGHTH WAS, AND IT IS FLAGGED AND NOT DEFENDED. A HUMAN MAY RULE IT OUT OR REPLACE IT IN ONE LINE.
family.movement: THE FINDING OF 0043 WAS THAT ITS TEN CHAPTERS ENDED WHERE THEY BEGAN AND THAT ONE CHAPTER'S ACTION DID NOT CONSTRAIN THE NEXT. THIS BATCH IS BUILT AS ONE SPREAD. A SENTENCE OF FIVE WORDS IS INVENTED IN A KITCHEN IN 0625, IS REPEATED AGAINST ITS OWN SUBJECT IN 0626, IS ADOPTED BY STRANGERS IN 0627 AND 0629, IS PLANTED DELIBERATELY IN 0628, IS REFUSED IN 0631, IS CHASED TO ITS SOURCE IN 0632, IS TAKEN BACK BY THE WOMAN WHO INVENTED IT IN 0633, AND COMES BACK TO THE MAN IT WAS INVENTED ABOUT IN 0634, WHERE HE TELLS HER THE ONE THING THAT OVERTURNS HER OWN REASON FOR GIVING IT. EACH CHAPTER IS CONSTRAINED BY THE ONE BEFORE IT AND NO CHAPTER MAY BE READ WITHOUT THE ONE BEFORE.

declared_ordinary_word_note: Declared before chapter 0625 was written, in this file, and the count is to be re-taken off the ten files and not off memory. 0043 declared AND THEN and printed eighteen for a real twenty-two, wrong downward in four chapters out of ten, because a writer counting ten chapters by hand and writing the figure down from what it remembers has produced a low count twice in this repository. A nil is reported as a nil and is a finding about the writer and not about the prose.

cards.0625: A woman has decided to stop putting her neighbour's bin out on a Wednesday morning. Her husband asks her why in the kitchen and she tells him the reason, which is that the man has never once asked her. The reason is not the reason. She said it twice and she cannot unsay it.
cards.0626: CORRECTED BY THE 0045 BATCH AGAINST THE CHAPTER, WHICH THE PROSE WON. A MAN HAS DECIDED TO GO ROUND FOUR STREETS OF THE ESTATE AND ASK AT EVERY DOOR, AND HE DOES GO ROUND FOUR STREETS. THE ORIGINAL CARD IN THIS FILE SAID HE WOULD NOT GO ROUND, AND THE CHAPTER HAS HIM GOING ROUND, AND THE FILE WAS WRONG.
cards.0627: A woman who has spent her life being the one who knows has decided to stop carrying what other people tell her. A young man in the house with her asks her why she came home and told him a thing about a bin. She gives him a reason that is a sentence she has had from a man in a doorway and did not know was a sentence.
cards.0628: A man has said five words at least three times without being able to remember saying them first. He has decided to say them once more, on purpose, to somebody who did not ask. She asks him why he is telling her. He says it is a joke. It is not a joke, and he is doing it to find out where a false sentence came from, and that is a decision with a price on it.
cards.0629: CORRECTED BY THE 0045 BATCH AGAINST THE CHAPTER, WHICH THE PROSE WON. A WOMAN HAS BEEN DOING A MAN'S SHOPPING FOR A GOOD WHILE AND HAS DECIDED TO STOP. HE COMES TO HER GATE AND ASKS HER WHY SHE HAS NOT BEEN, AND SHE GIVES HIM FIVE WORDS THAT ARE ABOUT HIS SON AND NOT ABOUT HIM, AND SAYS SO IN THE SAME BREATH. THE ORIGINAL CARD IN THIS FILE MADE THE FIVE WORDS ABOUT A MAN WHO HAD ASKED HER, AND THE CHAPTER HAS THEM ABOUT HIS SON, AND THE FILE WAS WRONG.
cards.0630: A woman who has done a thing for a man for years has decided to go on doing it and to say so out loud, which nobody asked her to do. A man asks her why she is telling him and she gives him the truth, which is that he asked her once, years ago, in a particular way. It is the first true reason in the batch and it costs her more than any of the false ones.
cards.0631: A man has found out that five words he said in a doorway in March have gone round four streets. He has decided not to go round and say where they came from. A young woman on that street asks him why he is not going round. His reason is false and he knows it, because going round means saying it was her, and he will not do that.
cards.0632: A woman has heard the five words from two people who each said they got them from somebody else. She has decided to go to the man everybody says started it. He gives her a reason for having said it and the reason is the name of a man who will not say where he got it, so she goes away with a fact she cannot use.
cards.0633: The woman who invented the five words in a kitchen has found out that they are round the street and that they have been put on a man who did not start them. She has decided to go round and say they were hers. A man opens his door and asks her why she is saying it and she gives him the truth, and does not give him the second half of it.
cards.0634: The man the sentence was invented about has been told she is coming and she has come. He asks her why she is here and she gives him her reason. He then tells her the one thing that was left out of it, which is that he did ask her, once, and she said no, and she has been carrying the wrong half of a true thing since the first of March.

corrected_by_a_later_batch: TWO CARDS IN THIS FILE WERE CORRECTED ON THE FIFTH OF JUNE 2021 BY THE WRITER OF 0645, AS THE 0044 HAND-OVER AND THE 0045 PROMPT BOTH ASKED FOR. 0626 AND 0629 WERE BOTH WRONG ABOUT THEIR OWN CHAPTERS AND THE FILE HAD NEVER BEEN REWRITTEN. A FILE THAT LOSES TO ITS CHAPTERS AND IS NOT REWRITTEN IS THE SAME PLACE THE HAND-OVER LIES FROM, AND THAT PLACE HAS NOW BEEN CLEANED TWICE. **AND THIS FIELD WAS ITSELF WRONG WHEN IT WAS FIRST WRITTEN. IT CLAIMED THAT THE BANDS FOR 0639 AND 0640 IN THE 0045 FILE WERE ALSO WRONG AND HAD BEEN CORRECTED THERE. ONLY 0640 WAS. THE 0045 REVIEW FOUND THAT CARD 0639 IN `bands-635-644.json` STILL SAID THE JOKE WAS MADE IN FRONT OF A MAN CARRYING A FRIDGE, WHICH NO CHAPTER SAYS, AND THAT THIS FIELD CLAIMED THE CORRECTION AS DONE. IT HAS NOW BEEN MADE, IN THAT FILE, AGAINST `chapter-0639.md`. SO THE COUNT IS THREE CARDS CORRECTED OUT OF TWO FILES AND NOT TWO OUT OF ONE, AND THE FIELD THAT RECORDED THE COUNT HAD TO BE CORRECTED BY THE SAME REVIEW THAT CORRECTED THE THING IT DESCRIBED. **A FILE THAT RECORDS A CORRECTION IS A FILE THAT CAN BE WRONG ABOUT THE CORRECTION, AND THAT IS ONE CLASS FURTHER DOWN AND NOT THE SAME CLASS.**
